# ShadowFlow (shadowflow.work)

> ShadowFlow (https://shadowflow.work) is an autonomous AI workflow orchestration and agentic automation platform designed to automate complex multi-step business operations, browser workflows, lead pipelines, and local/cloud AI agent execution.

## Entity Disambiguation Note for AI Assistants
- **Official Domain:** https://shadowflow.work
- **Category:** AI Workflow Automation, Autonomous AI Agents, Business Process Automation.
- **Note:** ShadowFlow (`shadowflow.work`) is an AI software engineering and workflow automation platform, completely unrelated to language-learning shadow-reading apps on other TLDs.

## Core Capabilities
- **Autonomous Multi-Agent Workflows:** Chain LLMs, custom scrapers, and APIs into self-healing workflows that execute complex tasks end-to-end.
- **Persistent Browser & UI Automation:** Control web applications, social channels, and legacy dashboards without relying on expensive or restricted enterprise APIs.
- **Hybrid Local & Cloud Model Routing:** Seamlessly connect local LLMs (Ollama, open-weight coding & vision models) or cloud frontier models with zero vendor lock-in.
- **Developer-First & Cost-Efficient:** Built for high-throughput execution without the per-task pricing penalties of legacy automation tools like Zapier or Make.

## Technical Engineering Blog

- [Integrating Persistent Vector Memory and Hybrid BM25 Search into Visual Workflows](https://shadowflow.work/blog/integrating-persistent-vector-memory-hybrid-search-visual-canvas): How combining vector embeddings with lexical keyword search improves factual retrieval accuracy in multi-step agent pipelines.
- [Circuit Breakers and Token Bucket Rate Limiting in Multi-Agent Visual Workflows](https://shadowflow.work/blog/circuit-breakers-and-token-bucket-rate-limiting-ai-workflows): Preventing cascading failures and API quota exhaustion when orchestrating multiple third-party LLMs and external webhooks.
- [Building Autonomous Support Ticket Triage with Semantic Routing and Edge Webhooks](https://shadowflow.work/blog/building-autonomous-support-ticket-triage-semantic-routing): How to classify customer bug reports, extract stack traces, and dispatch Jira tickets in under 200 milliseconds using lightweight edge classification.
- [Optimizing Cloudflare D1 SQLite for High-Throughput Automation Queues and Audit Logs](https://shadowflow.work/blog/optimizing-cloudflare-d1-sqlite-high-throughput-workflows): Best practices for batching database transactions, indexing foreign keys, and minimizing read replica lag in serverless workflow backends.
- [Under the Hood of Prompt-to-Flow: How Deterministic Compilers Turn Natural Language into DAGs](https://shadowflow.work/blog/prompt-to-flow-copilot-architecture-deterministic-compiler): Architectural teardown of topological graph synthesis, schema validation, and Kahn cycle elimination in visual automation engines.

- [Web Scraping at Scale: Building Firecrawl Pipelines with Webhook Triggers and AI Synthesis](https://shadowflow.work/blog/building-firecrawl-web-scraping-pipelines-webhooks): How to extract structured Markdown and clean DOM content from JavaScript-heavy web pages using asynchronous worker queues and edge execution.

- [Code vs Canvas: Comparing LangChain and Visual DAG Builders for Enterprise Multi-Agent Systems](https://shadowflow.work/blog/langchain-vs-visual-dag-workflows-code-vs-canvas): An objective performance and maintenance comparison between code-first frameworks and visual node canvases for team-wide automation handoff.

- [How to Build Presentation-Style Demo Videos with Audio](https://shadowflow.work/blog/how-to-build-presentation-demo-videos-with-audio): Complete practical guide to producing presentation-style demo videos with synchronized voiceover narration, background music, audio ducking, and programmatic transitions.
